council_plague_treatises.name: Council Plague Treatises
council_plague_treatises.observation: The town's physicians write the council a treatise on what to do when the plague comes: whom to shut up, what to burn and whom to pay.

forty_day_quarantine.name: Forty-Day Quarantine
forty_day_quarantine.observation: Ships and travellers from a sick place must wait forty days apart before they may land or enter.
forty_day_quarantine.ability_reason: Forty days outlasts nearly every carrier; pestilence reaches the town less often, and ports that keep the rule are trusted.
forty_day_quarantine.social_consequence: Merchants rage at the lost weeks, and smuggling around the quarantine becomes a trade of its own.

health_passes.name: Health Passes
health_passes.observation: Travellers carry a sealed pass naming the plague-free town they came from, and gate guards turn back those without one.

quarantine_island_station.name: Quarantine Island
quarantine_island_station.observation: A pest house on an island keeps the sick apart from the suspect, and ships' goods are aired in its sheds before they come ashore.
quarantine_island_station.ability_reason: The sick and the suspect are held on an island away from the town, so a landed pestilence can be caught before it spreads.
quarantine_island_station.social_consequence: Those sent to the island often do not return, and families hide their sick rather than let them go.

leper_house_conversion.name: Plague Houses from Leper Houses
leper_house_conversion.observation: The leper houses outside the walls stand nearly empty, and the town turns them into houses for the plague-stricken.

pestilence_market_seals.name: Pestilence Market Seals
pestilence_market_seals.observation: In plague years market officers burn rotten food and hang a seal on the door of any shop where the sickness has been.

concave_spectacles.name: Spectacles for the Short-Sighted
concave_spectacles.observation: Lenses ground hollow let the short-sighted see across a room, and a scholar can recognise his friends in the street.

incurables_hospital.name: Hospital for Incurables
incurables_hospital.observation: A hospital takes in the incurable sick whom the other hospitals turn away, and nurses them until they die.

printed_plague_regimens.name: Printed Plague Regimens
printed_plague_regimens.observation: Cheap printed sheets tell householders how to air rooms, what to eat and which remedies to buy when plague comes.

printed_dissection_manual.name: Printed Dissection Manual
printed_dissection_manual.observation: A printed manual guides the anatomy lesson step by step, so each dissection teaches the same parts in the same order.

sweating_fever_record.name: Sweating Fever Recorded
sweating_fever_record.observation: Physicians write down a new sweating fever that kills within a day, noting the season, the course and who falls sick.

standing_health_magistracy.name: Standing Health Magistracy
standing_health_magistracy.observation: The health magistrates meet every week in plague-free years too, watching the ports, the drains, the markets and the burials.
standing_health_magistracy.ability_reason: The health office no longer rises only when plague arrives; it watches ports, drains, markets and burials every year.
standing_health_magistracy.social_consequence: The magistrates can close markets, burn goods and shut houses, and many townsfolk fear them more than the sickness.

field_surgery_handbook.name: Field Surgery Handbook
field_surgery_handbook.observation: A wound surgery handbook in the common tongue goes into every army surgeon's pack.

great_pox_recognition.name: The New Pox Recognized
great_pox_recognition.observation: Physicians see that the new pox passes between bedfellows, and treat its sores with quicksilver salves and sweating.
great_pox_recognition.ability_reason: The new pox is known as a disease of the bed; it can be named, avoided and treated, though quicksilver poisons as it cures.
great_pox_recognition.social_consequence: Shame follows the pox; it is blamed on foreigners, and each people names it after its neighbours.

ship_bills_of_health.name: Ship Bills of Health
ship_bills_of_health.observation: Every ship carries a sealed bill from its last port declaring whether sickness was there, and the harbour master reads it before anyone lands.

bathhouse_closures.name: Bathhouses Shut
bathhouse_closures.observation: The town shuts its bathhouses and stews against the new pox, and the steam rooms stand cold.
bathhouse_closures.social_consequence: Townsfolk lose their baths along with the brothels, and for generations the poor go unwashed.

college_of_physicians.name: College of Physicians
college_of_physicians.observation: A college of physicians examines and licenses every healer in the capital and fines those who practise without its letter.
college_of_physicians.ability_reason: No one may practise physic in the capital without the college's examination, and the worst quacks are driven out.
college_of_physicians.social_consequence: Unlicensed healers, many of them women and cunning folk, are fined and driven out, and the poor lose their cheapest help.

guaiac_pox_remedy.name: Guaiac Wood Remedy
guaiac_pox_remedy.observation: Shavings of a hard wood from across the ocean are boiled into a drink against the pox, gentler than quicksilver if less sure.

from_life_printed_herbals.name: Herbals Drawn from Life
from_life_printed_herbals.observation: New herbals are printed from drawings made of living plants, and an apothecary can tell the true herb from its lookalike.

gentle_gunshot_dressing.name: Mild Gunshot Dressing
gentle_gunshot_dressing.observation: A surgeon who ran out of boiling oil dressed gunshot wounds with a mild salve, and those men healed better than the scalded.
gentle_gunshot_dressing.ability_reason: Wounded men dressed with a mild salve live more often and heal cleaner than those scalded with oil, and generals keep more veterans.

dissection_anatomy_atlas.name: Anatomy Atlas
dissection_anatomy_atlas.observation: A great atlas drawn from dissected bodies shows muscles, vessels and organs as they are, and corrects the old authorities in hundreds of places.
dissection_anatomy_atlas.ability_reason: Anatomy is taught from the body itself; surgeons cut with a true map, and the old authorities can be corrected.
dissection_anatomy_atlas.social_consequence: Anatomists need bodies, and the gallows and the paupers' graveyard supply them, to the townsfolk's horror.

faculty_physic_garden.name: Physic Garden
faculty_physic_garden.observation: The medical faculty keeps a walled garden where students learn the healing plants growing in labelled beds.

contagion_seeds_treatise.name: Seeds of Contagion
contagion_seeds_treatise.observation: A physician argues that disease passes in unseen seeds, by touch, by clothes and goods, and through the air over distance.
contagion_seeds_treatise.ability_reason: Disease is understood to travel by touch, goods and air, which gives reasons for burning bedding, airing houses and keeping the sick apart.

spotted_fever_distinction.name: Spotted Fever Named
spotted_fever_distinction.observation: Physicians tell the spotted fever of camps and jails from other fevers by its rash and its course.

printed_city_pharmacopoeia.name: City Pharmacopoeia
printed_city_pharmacopoeia.observation: The city prints one book of remedies by law, and every apothecary must compound to its recipes.

chemical_medicine_school.name: Chemical Medicine
chemical_medicine_school.observation: Chemical doctors prepare drugs from metals and salts by fire, and dose antimony, mercury and iron where the old school gave herbs.
chemical_medicine_school.social_consequence: Old physicians and chemical doctors quarrel in print, and patients are dosed with antimony by one and bled by the other.

amputation_ligature.name: Tied Arteries
amputation_ligature.observation: Surgeons tie off the arteries with thread when they take off a limb, instead of searing the stump with hot irons.

jointed_artificial_limbs.name: Jointed Iron Limbs
jointed_artificial_limbs.observation: Armourers make iron hands with jointed fingers for maimed soldiers, and a man can hold a rein or a cup again.

army_field_hospitals.name: Army Field Hospitals
army_field_hospitals.observation: Tents, wagons, surgeons and nurses march with the army, and the wounded are treated a day's march behind the line.

corpse_searchers.name: Corpse Searchers
corpse_searchers.observation: Sworn women view every corpse in the parish and report to the clerk what they judge the person died of.

tiered_anatomy_theatre.name: Anatomy Theatre
tiered_anatomy_theatre.observation: A round theatre of steep wooden benches lets two hundred students see the dissector's hands at once.

arm_flap_nose_repair.name: Nose Repair from the Arm
arm_flap_nose_repair.observation: A surgeon raises a flap of skin on the arm, binds the arm to the face for weeks, and shapes a new nose from it.

folk_variolation.name: Folk Variolation
folk_variolation.observation: Mothers and healers scratch smallpox matter into a child's skin, or blow dried scabs into the nose, to give a mild case in a good season.
folk_variolation.ability_reason: A mild case given on purpose spares a child the killing smallpox, though some so treated still die of it.

lemon_juice_scurvy.name: Lemon Juice Against Scurvy
lemon_juice_scurvy.observation: A ship's captain gives each man a spoonful of lemon juice daily, and his crew reaches port while others are dying of scurvy.

shut_up_plague_houses.name: Shut-Up Plague Houses
shut_up_plague_houses.observation: Any house with the plague is shut up with its whole household, marked with a cross, and a watchman stands at the door.
shut_up_plague_houses.social_consequence: Whole families are nailed in with the sick; many flee at night, and hatred of the watchmen runs deep.

sea_surgeons_chest.name: Sea Surgeon's Chest
sea_surgeons_chest.observation: Every ship and garrison carries a surgeon's chest packed to a list, with a manual telling a mate what to do with each item.

chartered_apothecary_company.name: Apothecaries' Company
chartered_apothecary_company.observation: The apothecaries win a charter of their own apart from the grocers, and their wardens search shops for bad drugs.

blood_circulation.name: Circulation of the Blood
blood_circulation.observation: A physician shows by measure and by tying veins that the heart pumps the same blood round the body again and again.
blood_circulation.ability_reason: The heart is known to drive the same blood round and round, which overturns the old account and opens a new study of the living body.
blood_circulation.social_consequence: The old professors refuse it for a generation, and young physicians who teach it lose patients.

charity_nursing_sisters.name: Sisters of Charity
charity_nursing_sisters.observation: Unmarried sisters living under a simple rule nurse the sick poor in their homes and in the town hospitals.

university_clinical_wards.name: Clinical Wards
university_clinical_wards.observation: Students follow the professor from bed to bed in the university hospital, and learn physic at the bedside instead of from the book.

cinchona_fever_bark.name: Fever Bark
cinchona_fever_bark.observation: A bitter bark from across the ocean, ground and taken in wine, stops the shaking fever of the marshes.
cinchona_fever_bark.ability_reason: A bark from across the ocean stops the shaking fever, and marsh country and hot garrisons become livable.

general_confinement_hospital.name: General Hospital
general_confinement_hospital.observation: A great general hospital takes in the sick, the old and the idle poor, and sets those who can to work.
general_confinement_hospital.ability_reason: The state gathers the sick, the old and the idle poor under one roof and one rule.
general_confinement_hospital.social_consequence: The poor dread the general hospital as a prison; beggars are rounded up by archers and families hide their old.

opium_tincture.name: Opium Tincture
opium_tincture.observation: Opium dissolved in wine and spices is dosed by the drop against pain, coughs and fluxes.
opium_tincture.social_consequence: Some patients cannot stop taking the drops, and the physicians do not yet know why.

capillary_observation.name: Capillaries Seen
capillary_observation.observation: Under a strong lens, tiny vessels are seen in a frog's lung, joining the arteries to the veins.

transfusion_ban.name: Transfusion Forbidden
transfusion_ban.observation: Physicians try pouring lamb's blood into men; after a patient dies the courts forbid it.

invalid_soldiers_hospital.name: Invalid Soldiers' Hospital
invalid_soldiers_hospital.observation: A great hospital houses maimed and worn-out soldiers, and others draw a pension in their villages.
invalid_soldiers_hospital.social_consequence: Veterans no longer beg at the town gate, and recruits sign on more willingly for it.

epidemic_season_records.name: Epidemic Season Records
epidemic_season_records.observation: A physician records each year's fevers beside the weather and the season, and sees which years breed which sickness.

ergot_cause_identified.name: Ergot Named
ergot_cause_identified.observation: Physicians trace the burning sickness to black spurs on rye in wet years, and millers are ordered to sieve them out.
ergot_cause_identified.ability_reason: The burning sickness is traced to blighted rye; sieving and refusing spurred grain spares whole villages.

regimental_surgeons.name: Regimental Surgeons
regimental_surgeons.observation: Every regiment has its own surgeon and mate on the muster roll, paid by the crown.

state_medical_collegium.name: State Medical College
state_medical_collegium.observation: One state college examines and licenses physicians, surgeons, apothecaries and midwives in every province.
state_medical_collegium.ability_reason: Healing across the whole realm answers to one college, which sets standards for every kind of healer, midwives included.

ipecac_flux_remedy.name: Flux Root
ipecac_flux_remedy.observation: A root from across the ocean, given in small doses, eases the bloody flux that kills children in summer.

medical_case_journals.name: Medical Journals
medical_case_journals.observation: Physicians print their cases and remedies in journals, and a good cure is tried in other towns within the year.

spa_town_physicians.name: Spa Towns
spa_town_physicians.observation: Towns around mineral springs keep physicians, pump rooms and bathing rules, and the rich come to take the waters.

trade_diseases_treatise.name: Diseases of the Trades
trade_diseases_treatise.observation: A physician describes the sicknesses of each trade, from miners' lungs to gilders' shaking, and how to lessen them.

pulse_watch.name: Pulse Watch
pulse_watch.observation: Physicians count the pulse against a small watch with a second hand, and write the number down.

screw_tourniquet.name: Screw Tourniquet
screw_tourniquet.observation: A strap tightened by a screw stops the blood in a limb, so the surgeon can amputate without a flood.

frontier_sanitary_cordon.name: Sanitary Cordon
frontier_sanitary_cordon.observation: A line of garrisoned posts along the frontier holds every traveller and bale in quarantine before they may pass.
frontier_sanitary_cordon.ability_reason: Plague from the neighbouring lands is stopped at the border by a standing line of guarded quarantine posts.
frontier_sanitary_cordon.social_consequence: Soldiers shoot those who cross the cordon at night, and border villages live under guard in plague years.

variolation_trials.name: Variolation Trials
variolation_trials.observation: Condemned prisoners and orphans given the mild smallpox all survive, and physicians report it to the court.
variolation_trials.ability_reason: Prisoners and orphans given the mild smallpox survive, and physicians and parents begin to trust the method.
variolation_trials.social_consequence: Preachers call it tempting fate, and when an inoculated child dies the family is cursed in the street.

subscription_hospitals.name: Subscription Hospitals
subscription_hospitals.observation: Subscribers pay a yearly sum to fund a hospital and each may send in a set number of sick poor.

lateral_lithotomy.name: Lateral Lithotomy
lateral_lithotomy.observation: A surgeon cuts into the bladder from the side and takes out the stone in under a minute, and most patients live.

dental_surgery.name: Dental Surgery
dental_surgery.observation: Dentists scale teeth, fill holes with lead and gold, and set false teeth on springs.

anatomical_wax_models.name: Anatomical Wax Models
anatomical_wax_models.observation: Coloured wax models of the body, the womb and the child within teach students in any season without a corpse.

maize_skin_sickness.name: Maize Skin Sickness
maize_skin_sickness.observation: A physician describes the rough red skin, the flux and the madness of the poor who live on maize alone, and advises milk and meat.

ventilator_bellows.name: Ventilator Bellows
ventilator_bellows.observation: Great bellows worked by hand pump the foul air out of ships' holds and prison cells.

surgeons_college.name: Surgeons' College
surgeons_college.observation: The surgeons leave the barbers' company and form their own college, with examinations in anatomy and operations.

smallpox_hospital.name: Smallpox Hospital
smallpox_hospital.observation: A hospital outside the town takes in the smallpox sick and inoculates the poor in batches.

scurvy_controlled_trial.name: Scurvy Trial
scurvy_controlled_trial.observation: A ship's surgeon gives six pairs of scurvy-sick sailors six different remedies; the pair given oranges and lemons recovers.
scurvy_controlled_trial.ability_reason: The cure for scurvy is proved by comparing remedies side by side, not by authority.

cataract_extraction.name: Cataract Extraction
cataract_extraction.observation: A surgeon lifts the clouded lens out of the eye through a small cut, and the blind see again with thick spectacles.

preventive_inoculation.name: Organized Inoculation
preventive_inoculation.observation: Towns and households inoculate their children against smallpox in organized rounds, in a healthy season and with rest after.
preventive_inoculation.ability_reason: Whole towns are inoculated in season, and smallpox, the great killer of children, loses much of its hold.
preventive_inoculation.social_consequence: Inoculated children spread the smallpox to neighbours who refused it, and quarrels over the practice split towns.

gastric_digestion_experiments.name: Digestion Experiments
gastric_digestion_experiments.observation: Food in perforated tubes swallowed and drawn back up is found dissolved by the stomach's juices, not ground or cooked.

bedside_thermometer.name: Bedside Thermometer
bedside_thermometer.observation: Physicians read a glass thermometer under the tongue in fevers and record the heat day by day.

chest_percussion.name: Chest Percussion
chest_percussion.observation: A physician taps the chest with his fingers and hears where fluid or hardness lies beneath.

organ_seat_pathology.name: Seats of Disease
organ_seat_pathology.observation: Hundreds of autopsies compared with the patients' symptoms show that each disease has its seat in a particular organ.
organ_seat_pathology.ability_reason: Diseases are traced to their seat in the organs, and physicians begin to treat the organ, not the humours.

deaf_sign_school.name: School for the Deaf
deaf_sign_school.observation: A school teaches deaf children to sign, read and write, and they can learn a trade and speak for themselves.

mass_shallow_inoculation.name: Village Inoculation
mass_shallow_inoculation.observation: Inoculators with a quick shallow scratch and no long preparation treat whole villages in a day, rich and poor alike.

drowning_rescue_societies.name: Rescue Societies
drowning_rescue_societies.observation: Rescue societies keep kits along the rivers and pay a reward to anyone who revives a drowned person with warmth and breath.

outpatient_dispensaries.name: Dispensaries
outpatient_dispensaries.observation: Dispensaries give free drugs and send physicians to the homes of the poor, and many sick children are treated where they lie.

prison_hygiene_reform.name: Prison Hygiene
prison_hygiene_reform.observation: Prisons are washed, whitewashed and aired, and prisoners bathed, and the jail fever that killed judges and jurors abates.

medical_police_code.name: Medical Police
medical_police_code.observation: A state code of public health rules on burials, markets, wells, midwives, nuisances and the care of the poor.
medical_police_code.ability_reason: Public health becomes a code of state: burials, markets, water, midwives and nuisances all fall under one law.
medical_police_code.social_consequence: Officials enter homes and workshops to inspect them, and householders complain of meddling in private life.

blind_reading_school.name: School for the Blind
blind_reading_school.observation: A school teaches blind children to read letters raised on the page with their fingertips.

foxglove_dropsy.name: Foxglove for Dropsy
foxglove_dropsy.observation: A physician doses foxglove leaf for dropsy, raising the dose by trial and stopping when the pulse slows or the patient sickens.

town_fever_houses.name: Fever Houses
town_fever_houses.observation: Towns open fever houses where those with contagious fevers are taken from crowded lodgings and nursed apart.

moral_treatment_asylums.name: Moral Treatment
moral_treatment_asylums.observation: The keepers strike off the chains of the mad and give them work, air and kind handling.
moral_treatment_asylums.ability_reason: The mad are unchained and given work, air and kindness, and many recover who would have died in chains.

litter_bearer_drill.name: Litter Bearer Drill
litter_bearer_drill.observation: Drilled bearers carry the wounded off the field on litters to the surgeons, instead of leaving them where they fell.

fleet_citrus_ration.name: Fleet Citrus Ration
fleet_citrus_ration.observation: By order every ship in the fleet issues lemon juice with the daily ration, and scurvy all but vanishes from the lower decks.

cowpox_vaccination.name: Cowpox Vaccination
cowpox_vaccination.observation: Matter from the cowpox of a milkmaid's hand is scratched into a child's arm, and the child cannot then take the smallpox.
cowpox_vaccination.ability_reason: A cowpox scratch protects against smallpox without the danger of the smallpox itself, so everyone can be protected safely.
cowpox_vaccination.social_consequence: Caricaturists draw the vaccinated growing horns, and the old inoculators fight the new method for their trade.
